in_marathi.name: Bhagavathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagavathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagavathi is the name of a Hindu goddess, often depicted with multiple arms holding various symbols of abundance and prosperity. She is revered as the goddess of wealth, fertility, and prosperity. The name Bhagavathi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhag’, meaning fortune or wealth.
